video.desc:
Netshort好像赶工 这部怎么也不完结

In a werewolf fortress, captains Rayne and Kane are chained by magic. Kane hides sister Lily as a soldier. During blood moon heat, Rayne shields Kane. When Lily is exposed, Rayne claims her as his luna. Heartbroken Kane learns Rayne took poisoned arrow for him; they confess and form a lifelong bond.

在一座狼人堡垒中，两位队长 Rayne 与 Kane 被魔法锁链彼此束缚。Kane 把妹妹 Lily 伪装成士兵藏在军中。血月发情期降临时，Rayne 挺身护住了 Kane。Lily 身份暴露后，Rayne 却宣布立她为自己的 Luna。心碎的 Kane 后来得知，Rayne 曾替他挡下一支毒箭——两人终于坦白心意，缔结终生羁绊。
